verdict.rationale: Factory's tiered autonomy in droid exec lets you require manual confirmation before certain operations run, and Missions/Custom Droids let scoped tasks be defined and orchestrated, which loosely supports a pre-execution gate, but there is no documented explicit 'scope/contract sign-off' step or approval gate before an agent starts modifying the repo — the closest workflow shown (diff review) happens after changes are made, not before. missing for 10: an explicit spec/contract approval UI or workflow prior to code modification, evidence of a lead-specific sign-off gate, and confirmation that tiered autonomy blocks repo writes until approved.
